name: Henry Moore, Attorney & Counsellor at Law

proprietors.name: Moore, Henry
proprietors.basis: The register matches the printed name to the town card moore_henry (action: enrich), so this is the same person the resident layer already holds. Dated by the printing window, which bounds the reading and does not date the partnership.

locations.basis: Placeable against the committed town. The landmark is the committed structure jh_kinzie_forwarding_store.
locations.limit_reason: The register places this house against jh_kinzie_forwarding_store and the town holds no roof of its own for it (action: new_building), so the anchor is as far as the reading goes.

dates.basis: No opening is announced. The first printing, 1835-08-05, is the bound: the house was trading by then and the record does not say when it began.

replaceable_by: A directory, a deed or a later reading that names this house's premises, its staff or its dates more exactly than the newspapers do.
